categories.description: Primary tumor cannot be assessed
Carcinoma in situ
Tumor ≤ 2 cm in greatest dimension
Tumor > 2 cm but ≤ 4 cm in greatest dimension
Tumor > 4 cm in greatest dimension or extension to lingual surface of epiglottis
Tumor of any size invading adjacent organ(s), such as larynx, extrinsic muscle of tongue, medial pterygoid, hard palate or mandible (moderately advanced local disease)
Tumor of any size invading adjacent organ(s), such as lateral pterygoid muscle, pterygoid plates, lateral nasopharynx, skull base, or encases carotid artery (very advanced local disease)

notes.larynx: Mucosal extension to lingual surface of epiglottis from primary tumor of the base of tongue and vallecula does not constitute invasion of the larynx.

categories.description: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed
No regional lymph node metastasis
Metastasis in a single ipsilateral lymph node, ≤ 3 cm in greatest dimension and extranodal extension (ENE)−

Metastasis in a single ipsilateral lymph node ≤ 3 cm and ENE+; or > 3 cm but ≤ 6 cm and ENE−; or multiple ipsilateral lymph nodes, none > 6 cm and ENE−; or bilateral or contralateral lymph node(s), none > 6 cm and ENE−
Single ipsilateral lymph node ≤ 3 cm and ENE+, or single ipsilateral lymph node > 3 cm but ≤ 6 cm and ENE−
Metastasis in multiple ipsilateral lymph nodes, none > 6 cm in greatest dimension and ENE−
Metastasis in bilateral or contralateral lymph node(s), none > 6 cm in greatest dimension and ENE−

Metastasis in a lymph node > 6 cm and ENE−; or a single ipsilateral node > 3 cm and ENE+; or multiple ipsilateral, contralateral or bilateral nodes, any with ENE+; or a single contralateral node of any size and ENE+
Metastasis in a lymph node > 6 cm in greatest dimension and ENE−
Single ipsilateral lymph node > 3 cm and ENE+; or multiple ipsilateral, contralateral or bilateral lymph nodes, any with ENE+; or a single contralateral lymph node of any size and ENE+

notes.u_l: Designation of 'U' or 'L' may be used for any N category to indicate metastasis above the lower border of the cricoid (U) or below the lower border of the cricoid (L).
notes.midline: Midline nodes are considered ipsilateral nodes.
notes.node_count: Per AJCC 8th edition, a selective neck dissection ordinarily includes 10+ lymph nodes and a comprehensive neck dissection (radical or modified radical) ordinarily includes 15+. Negative pathologic examination of a smaller number of nodes still mandates a pN0 designation.

categories.description: No distant metastasis
Distant metastasis
Clinical classification: stage assigned from imaging, endoscopy, biopsy, and clinical exam before any definitive treatment.
Pathological classification: stage assigned from the surgically resected specimen after histologic review.
Classification determined during or after the application of initial multimodal (neoadjuvant) therapy.
No neoadjuvant therapy preceded this assessment.

notes.matching: For p16- oropharyngeal SCC AJCC 8, no separate ypTNM stage table is defined; DescY does not affect the stage outcome.

categories.description: Recurrent tumor classification, assigned when the tumor is staged after a disease-free interval.
Not a recurrent tumor in this assessment.
